learning_outcomes.text: Present the different robot architectures and their main characteristics.
Perform kinematic modeling to discover robot properties, workspaces, and singularities.
Discuss trajectory generation in joint and Cartesian space.
Present the different types of robot trajectories and the link with industrial processes.
Discuss the concept of optimal placement and simple methods usable in robotic CAD software.
Acquire tools to choose a robot for an industrial application.
Illustrate course steps using DELMIA software to create a robot.
Illustrate course steps using DELMIA software to create a tool.
Illustrate course steps using DELMIA software to create a robotic cell with pick-and-place operations.
Illustrate course steps using DELMIA software to create a robotic cell with welding operations.
Relate to industrial applications using cobots and mobile robots.

syllabus_topics: Offline robot programming and UR5 practical work
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
